PC: Ask the nurse to underdress the patient, place them on a monitor, and obtain a set of vital signs
Obtain a history from the parent, including HPI, past, surgical, birth, family, and social histories
Ask the nurse to obtain IV access and draw labs
Administer a $2 0 \mathrm { c c } / \mathrm { k g }$ IV bolus of crystalloid fluid
Initiate a $2 ~ \mathrm { g / k g }$ IV infusion of IVIG
Administer a $2 5 \mathrm { m g / k g }$ dose of aspirin
MK: Review lab work and make a diagnosis of Incomplete Kawasaki Disease
SBP: Admit the patient to an inpatient pediatric service
ICS: Explain the leading differential diagnosis and disposition to parent
